coordinate_frame.name: observer-frame Cartesian comoving
coordinate_frame.conversion: L[Mpc/h] = h * L[Mpc]; L[Mpc] = L[Mpc/h] / h
coordinate_frame.unit_decision: graph and historical U-Net observer coordinates are comoving Mpc; T-Web smoothing remains Mpc/h
coordinate_frame.cross_cap_storage: forbidden; one immutable lattice and HDF5 file per cap

grid.selection_reason: 5 comoving Mpc (3.383 Mpc/h for Planck18) exactly matches the established U-Net representation and is feasible after cap separation and chunking; literal 5 Mpc/h is a distinct coarser ablation

angular_support.method: HEALPix occupancy from all parent observed galaxy positions
angular_support.status: P3a approximation; replace with a versioned random/exposure field in P3b

apodization.method: Cartesian Gaussian over analytic binary support with a fixed halo per output chunk

selection.interpolation: linear in z with endpoint clipping and ntilde_floor

contrast.name: log_count_ratio
contrast.definition: log((counts + epsilon) / (expected_counts + epsilon)) where exposure_apodized > minimum_exposure; zero otherwise

normalization.train_fitted_transforms: forbidden before P4 fold ownership; fit on training cores and store separately

completion_contract.authoritative_writer: p3a_build_canonical_fields.py after every validation gate passes
